It reads the bundled JSPEC2.SPI, star templates, GLXYTMPL.SP, NGC4889.SP and QSOSpect.dat itself and emits means, counts, totals, S/N, branch counts and the .SSP SHA-256. Derived from already-approved resources only; no new original bytes; plus template-requirements.json (each approved jspect2 template with its SHA-256, JSPEC2.SPI index and the field packs whose stars require it).

The three older Pleiades photometer field files publish whole 27-byte N2230 records for every band read, including binary-search probes and Dec-strip scan rows outside their field areas (distinct whole records outside every field area: pinned-pleiades-v.json 205 of 208, pleiades-target-fields.json 414 of 418, pleiades-expanded-fields.json 2552 of 2569). They stay unchanged under the 1279-resource approval because saved-file headers attest their SHA-256 (owner 1-5 photometer headers); any regeneration applies the position-only witness rule of the 2026-10-28 files (whole records only inside a field's own area, 8-byte witnesses elsewhere), and the reader enforces that rule strictly only for pleiades-variable-fields.json and pleiades-pointing-fields.json. Likewise, owner 4+ photometer headers attest integration-provenance.json (integrationContractSHA256), which still records browserPolicy.maximumEvents 256; the bound in force is 512 (core/photometer.ts, 2026-10-28), a web bound with no CLEA address. Generator hashes recorded anywhere in the repository are kept verifiable by read-only, hash-named copies in the research folder (analysis/generator-archive/, MANIFEST.json), outside the repository.
subsequentReviews.treatment: No resource bytes changed; the limitation and the in-force bound are recorded here.
